prompts.display_text: Pin a country with a temple that was dedicated 11 or more years after it was announced.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country with a temple that was dedicated 11 or more years after it was announced.
prompts.summary: Most temples are dedicated a few years after they are announced, but some wait more than a decade because of land, permits or unrest. Guayaquil and Bogota were announced in the early 1980s and dedicated in 1999, and Kyiv took 12 years.

answers.name: United States of America
answers.fact: Los Angeles California, announced 1937, dedicated 1956; Manti Utah, announced 1875, dedicated 1888; Salt Lake, announced 1847, dedicated 1893.

answers.name: Philippines
answers.fact: Urdaneta Philippines, announced 2010, dedicated 2024.

answers.name: Colombia
answers.fact: Bogotá Colombia, announced 1984, dedicated 1999.

answers.name: Ecuador
answers.fact: Guayaquil Ecuador, announced 1982, dedicated 1999.

answers.name: Ukraine
answers.fact: Kyiv Ukraine, announced 1998, dedicated 2010.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country with a city marked as a stop on the Joseph Smith Papers map of Orson Hyde's 1841 journey (not counting Jerusalem)
prompts.text_original: A country holding a city where Orson Hyde stopped on his 1841 mission journey from London to Jerusalem and back to Trieste, as mapped by the Joseph Smith Papers (Jerusalem itself not counted).
prompts.citation: Joseph Smith Papers map, Orson Hyde's mission travels June-December 1841; Saints vol. 1 ch. 36
prompts.note: Only the cities marked on the JSP map count. The Danube leg (Austria, Hungary, Serbia, Bulgaria, Romania) has no marked stops.
prompts.summary: In 1840 Orson Hyde saw London, Amsterdam, Constantinople and Jerusalem in vision and was sent to dedicate the Holy Land. He crossed Europe, sailed by way of Smyrna and Beirut to Jaffa, and prayed on the Mount of Olives on October 24, 1841. He returned through Egypt, Trieste and Germany and reached Nauvoo in December 1842.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: London, where he departed in June 1841 after helping the Twelve in England.

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Jaffa, where he landed in October 1841 before going inland to Jerusalem.

answers.name: Germany
answers.fact: Mainz, Frankfurt and Regensburg, where he boarded a Danube steamer in August 1841.

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: Damietta, Cairo and Alexandria on the way home, November 1841.

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: Constantinople (Istanbul) and Smyrna (Izmir).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Beirut, on the sea route from Smyrna to Jaffa.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: Rotterdam, Amsterdam and Arnhem.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: Trieste, then Austrian and now in Italy, reached in December 1841.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country holding Tyre, Zidon, Philistia, Egypt or Edom, judged in Joel 3, or Greece, where Judah's children were sold
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a land the Lord calls to account in Joel 3 (Tyre, Zidon, the coasts of Palestine, Egypt, Edom), or Greece, where Judah's children were sold
prompts.summary: Joel 3 rebukes Tyre, Zidon and the Philistine coast for selling the children of Judah to the Grecians, and says Judah will in turn sell their children to the Sabeans, an Arab tribe. It also foretells desolation for Egypt and Edom, while Judah and Jerusalem endure forever (Joel 3:19-20).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: Egypt shall be a desolation (Joel 3:19).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: The coasts of Palestine, the Philistine shore, held Ashkelon and Ashdod (Joel 3:4).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Tyre and Zidon are rebuked for selling the children of Judah (Joel 3:4).

answers.name: Jordan
answers.fact: Edom shall be a desolate wilderness (Joel 3:19).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: The Philistine coast of Joel 3:4 also held Gaza, now in the Gaza Strip.

answers.name: Greece
answers.fact: Judah's children were sold unto the Grecians (Joel 3:6).

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where an angel, vision or dream came on land to someone living in New Testament times (not the Transfiguration)
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a place on land where an angel appeared, or the Lord gave a vision or dream, to someone living in New Testament times, in the Gospels, Acts or Revelation (not the Transfiguration)
prompts.note: Bethlehem is in the West Bank (Palestine); Israel also counts.
prompts.summary: Heavenly messengers appear all through the New Testament. Gabriel came to Zacharias and Mary, angels sang to shepherds near Bethlehem, and an angel guided Joseph in Egypt. Saul met the Lord near Damascus, Paul saw the man of Macedonia at Troas, the Lord comforted him at Corinth, and John saw his Revelation on Patmos.

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Gabriel came to Zacharias in the temple and to Mary in Nazareth; Peter saw a vision at Joppa (Luke 1:11, 26; Acts 10:9-17).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: An angel appeared to shepherds near Bethlehem, where the wise men were also warned in a dream (Luke 2:8-9; Matthew 2:12).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: An angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt after Herod died (Matthew 2:19).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: Saul saw a light near Damascus, and Ananias saw the Lord in a vision there (Acts 9:3-12).

answers.name: Greece
answers.fact: The Lord spoke to Paul in a vision at Corinth, and John received the Revelation on Patmos (Acts 18:9; Revelation 1:9-10).

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: At Troas Paul saw a vision of a man of Macedonia pleading for help (Acts 16:8-9).

prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory Gordon B. Hinckley visited on his May 1996 Asia trip
prompts.text_original: In May 1996 President Gordon B. Hinckley toured Asia, dedicating the Hong Kong China Temple and offering prayers in Cambodia and Vietnam. A country or territory on that trip.
prompts.citation: Ensign, August 1996, News of the Church
prompts.summary: In May 1996 Gordon B. Hinckley met Saints across East Asia: Japan, Korea, Taiwan and the Philippines. He dedicated the Hong Kong China Temple, stopped in Shenzhen, dedicated Cambodia for preaching and prayed in Hanoi. Even a refueling stop on Saipan became a meeting with members.

answers.name: Hong Kong
answers.fact: He dedicated the Hong Kong China Temple, May 26-27.

answers.name: Japan
answers.fact: Tokyo, Osaka, Fukuoka and Naha, Okinawa.

answers.name: China
answers.fact: A stop in Shenzhen.

answers.name: South Korea
answers.fact: Pusan and Seoul.

answers.name: Philippines
answers.fact: Manila and Cebu.

answers.name: Taiwan
answers.fact: Taipei.

answers.name: Cambodia
answers.fact: In Phnom Penh he dedicated Cambodia for the preaching of the gospel.

answers.name: Northern Mariana Islands
answers.fact: A refueling stop on Saipan, where he met members.

answers.name: Vietnam
answers.fact: Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, where he offered an addendum prayer.
